text:
Type: metal two-door cabinet on legs
Use: storing media, books and supplies; living room, home office, bedroom, hallway
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: powder-coated steel body, doors and legs, small round knob
Colors: light grey
Shape: low wide box with two flat doors set in a thin frame, single small knob between the doors, four thin straight legs, crisp sharp edges, light and open, compact
Feel: cool, tidy, calm, utilitarian
Goes with: light wood, white walls, bold color accents; industrial, Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms and home offices

product.name: LIXHULT
product.description: Helps you keep track of small items like chargers, keys and wallets, or more bulky items like handbags and toys. It all depends on which of the 3 cabinet sizes you choose.
